Name: Force Converter

Name: Revving Up
Description:
While Movement Speed is at least ?m/s:
Grants a stack of Revving Up, with a maximum of 10 stacks.

Each Revving Up stack grants increased Critical Health Regeneration Speed. Does not affect Shields in any way.
By default, it takes 1.75 seconds for Critical Health to begin regenerating at a rate of 27.5%HP/s.
At x5 stacks, it takes 1.5 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of ~37.5% HP/s.
At x10 stacks, it takes 1.25 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of 45% HP/s

Sprinting: 5 seconds per stack, takes 45 seconds to max out regardless of speed.
Other movement (Jumping, Falling, Sword Swinging, Sparrows) greatly accelerate the rate based on their speed, down to a minimum of 1.25 seconds per stack.
Most easily achieved by using a Sparrow, as those reach the Movement Cap.

While Movement Speed is lower than 3m/s:
Rapidly removes 4 stacks per second after a 0.5 second delay.

While Fully Revved is ready:
Sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Name: Wrecker
Description:
Passively grants increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields, Overshields, Vehicles, and Constructs.
200% increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields and Combatant Overshields. Damage shows up as Yellow Numbers.
15% increased Kinetic Damage towards Constructs. Koregos is not a Construct lol
It's ALL Kinetic Damage, including Poison, Praxic Blade, and Unpowered/Glaive Melee!

Name: Concussive Rounds
Description:
Upon killing an Elite+ Combatant, or breaking a Combatant Shield with Kinetic Damage:
Triggers a disorienting Kinetic blast, dealing up to 162 Kinetic Damage, heavily staggering, and inflicting disorient to enemies within 10 meters for ? seconds.

Name: Opening Act
Description:
Upon scoring a Grenade Kill:
Grants Opening Act for 15 seconds.

Opening Act | +? Stability and +? Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. Primary Weapons are instead granted +? Stability and +? Reload Speed.

Name: Room Clearing
Description:
Upon scoring 3 Heat Weapons or Primary Weapon Kills within 4 seconds of each:
Grants Room Cleaning for 10 seconds.

Room Cleaning | +40 Grenade and +40 Weapons. Additionally, it grants +40 Ammo Generation for Heat Weapons and Primary Ammo Weapons.

Name: License to Thrill
Description:
On Grenade Ability Usage, or upon triggering either the Nanotech Tracer Missile Origin Trait or Quicksilver Storm's Missile Tracer: 
Grants a stack of License to Thrill for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Buff duration is refreshed upon retriggering.

License to Thrill | 12% [2%] Damage Resist against enemies within <5 metres, increased by +?% [?%] per stack afterwards, up to 30% [5%] Damage Resist.

Name: Lethal Weave
Description:
On Unraveled Enemy Kill:
10% Grenade Ability Energy.
+10% Special Ammo Progress if at maximum Grenade Ability Energy.

Name: Old Martian Diplomacy
Description:
On Weapon Stow after scoring an Elite+ or Guardian Kill:
Restores 40? HP and disorients Combatants within 12 meters.
Incurs a 2? second cooldown between activations

Name: High Noon
Description:
Upon readying a weapon:
7% Increased Precision Damage against Combatants for 4 seconds.

Bonus is doubled to 14% Increased Precision Damage for the following:
Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and Tex Mechanica Exotics.
Dead Man's Tale | Huckleberry | Last Word | Tarrabah | Chaperone | Prospector

Name: Scoot to Loot
Description:
Upon scooting:
Pick ups Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
+? Handling and +? Reload Speed for 10? seconds.

Name: Shoot to Scoot
Description:
Upon dealing Weapon Damage:
Increases Slide Distance by 33% for 3? seconds.

While scooting:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4)

Name: Crook and Flail
Description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Restores 70 HP.

Name: Gift of Sight
Description:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
Enhanced Radar for 5 seconds.

Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.

Name: Special Relativity
Description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Refills stowed Special Weapons.

Name: Superluminal Motion
Description:
Upon dealing Super Damage, while Movement Speed isn't 0m/s:
Restores 30 [15] HP/s for 11 seconds. 
Dealing Additional Super Damage refreshes the buff duration.

Name: Lucent Transmutation
Description:
Upon scoring 2 Powered Melee Kills or a finisher:
Generates a Light-Subclass Super-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Does nothing while a Stasis or Strand Super is equipped. Kills must be spaced out by at least ~0.2 seconds.

Name: Lucent Tithes
Description:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 50? HP and spawns 3 Loyal Void Moths that each grant 22.5HP Void Overshield to the user and their allies on impact.

Name: Fanfare
Description:
While Ammo = ≤50% of Magazine AND Ammo ≠ 0:
+15 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Does not trigger at 0 Ammo. rip bows, GLs, and Rockets

Name: Suros Harmony
Description:
Upon finishing a reload:
SUROS Harmony | +30? Handling and ?% Flinch Resist for 6 seconds.
Weapons that have the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait equipped, as well as SUROS Regime are additionally granted +15 Range. 
For some reason, the +Range benefit's timer begins only once you are able to shoot in the reload animation instead of when the ammo is refilled.

SUROS Harmony persists through stow, but only on the weapon that it was triggered on. 
Can be refreshed by retriggering the buff unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao.

Name: Watchtower
Description:
Upon scoring a kill while ADS:
Resist x2 (25% [5%]) until no longer ADS.

Name: Field Expertise
Description:
On Precision Kill:
Grants a stack of Field Expertise for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Scoring a Non-Precision Weapon Kill immediately removes all stacks.

Field Expertise x1 | 3.5% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x2 | 7% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x3 | 8% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x4 | 9% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x5 | 10% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist.

Name: Untold Greed
Description:
Upon picking up an Ammo Brick, an Orb of Power, on Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Grants a stack of Untold Greed, up to a maximum of 100 stacks.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Removes 10 stacks.

Untold Greed:
Up to +? Reload Speed and 15% Damage Resist at x25 stacks.
x5 = 6% DR | x10 = 9% DR | x15 = 11% DR | x20 = 13% DR | x25+ = 15% DR

Name: Overflowing Coffers
Description:
While at x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Orbs of Power grant +?% Super Energy.
Elemental Pickups are massively improved.

Firesprites (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Grenade Energy
Ionic Traces (+100% Class, +85% Grenade/Melee) | 11.25% Grenade/Melee + 13.5% Class -> 21% Grenade/Melee + 27% Class + 2% Super
Void Breaches (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Class Energy
Stasis Shards (+260%) | 10% -> 36% Melee Energy. Additive to Hunger's +60%, totalling 42.5% Energy per pickup.
Strand Tangles | 350% increased damage. Affects Whirling Maelstrom too!

Upon reaching Critical Health while having x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Consumes ALL STACKS to spawn 4 Orbs of Power that each grant ~3.15% Super Energy.
The Orbs of Power are ejected in front of the user at high speeds, likely clipping inside walls.

Looking upwards/downwards does not affect where the Orbs go.
Allied Guardians get the Orbs, too.
